episodes.title: Andrew and Tristan Tate Arrested in Miami — Extradition Fight Begins | True Crime News
episodes.description: On July 18th, U.S. Marshals arrested Andrew and Tristan Tate in Miami on a sealed warrant tied to a United Kingdom extradition request. The brothers — dual American-British citizens and two of the most-argued-about names on the internet — are facing 59 combined criminal charges in the UK, including rape, human trafficking, and offenses involving indecent images of a child. Separately, they've been indicted in Romania on trafficking and organized-crime charges dating back to 2023, with new charges added just this month. They deny all of the accusations. Vanessa walks you through four years of investigation across three countries, and the extradition fight that just began in Florida. episodes.title: Epstein Investigation: Attorney Mary David Explains Challenges Behind Prosecuting Human-Trafficking Networks | Crime House 24/7
episodes.description: Welcome to Crime House 24/7. Vanessa Richardson sits down with attorney and human-trafficking expert Mary David for an extended discussion about the Jeffrey Epstein investigation — often referred to as “the Epstein Files.” In this special segment, Mary explains how federal prosecutors alleged Epstein’s sex-trafficking operation functioned, the legal elements required to prove trafficking crimes, and the challenges investigators face when building cases involving grooming, recruitment, and exploitation of minors. Plus, the two examine how depositions and testimony from individuals connected to Epstein can help investigators understand the scope of his network and the broader implications for trafficking investigations moving forward. episodes.title: Mother Found Not Guilty by Reason of Insanity in Son’s Drowning | Crime House 24/7
episodes.description: Vanessa Richardson brings you the latest breaking true crime stories. An Ohio judge has found an Amish mother not guilty by reason of insanity in the drowning death of her four-year-old son at Atwood Lake — a case investigators say unfolded during a shared spiritual delusion that also led to the drowning death of her husband. In Utah, a missing persons investigation has turned into a homicide case after a woman’s body was discovered inside her husband’s camper at a storage facility, while the husband fled the state and is now considered a person of interest. In Arkansas, a man charged with murdering the alleged abuser of his teenage daughter has won the Republican primary for county sheriff while awaiting trial. And in New York, singer Justin Timberlake is suing to block the release of police body camera footage from his 2024 drunken driving arrest.
